rows.label: Vastilok
rows.note: built and ready to equip; no Foundry step

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Vastilok isn't guaranteed to be up even when he is.
MR 9 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.
Any rank, Forma or Catalyst makes it untradeable — keep it stock if you plan to sell or gift it.

disclosures.title: why it's worth the wait
disclosures.body: Its ranged shot fires 9 pellets; with Shattering Impact one shot strips up to 54 armor, against 6 from a single-projectile gunblade like Stropha. Cheaper armor-strip options exist (Unairu's Caustic Strike, Sarpa) if you don't want to wait for Baro.
